chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Redman forms his band from Horace Henderson's men
summary: Redman took Bob Carroll, Rupert Cole, Talcott Reeves and Manzie Johnson from Horace Henderson's band to form his own in 1931.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now Bob Carroll came to New York with Horace Henderson, you see, and when Don formed his band he took some of the guys out of Horace's band to form the band and Bob Carroll was one of them.
Rupert Cole was the alto player with Horace, Talcott Reeves was the guitar player with Horace, Manzie Mansy Johnson was the drummer with Horace.
That's Horace Henderson, Fletcher Henderson's brother?
[ getting] the band. What year about was that, Butter, approximately?
1931 Don got that band together. He left McKinney's Cottonpickers in December -- no, September 1931.
